raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Agent details Prepared with AI assistance. Place MTP1 and an embedding replica on the final virtual stage, keep canonical checkpoint keys, and reuse pipeline_llm for construction and scheduling. Shifted IDs remain rank-local inputs; only hidden activations cross pipeline edges. Split the existing PP group collectively when only the two embedding owners need communication. GraphTrainer and pipeline context parallelism remain explicit future work. ## Test Plan ```bash python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/cpu/distributed/test_pipeline_parallel.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/test_loss.py -q python -m tests.integration_tests.run_tests ./outputs/ci4 --test_name deepseek_v3_mtp_pp2_dp2_ep2 --test_suite features --ngpu 4 --execution_mode real_pg --test_scope real_pg_required ``` --- Stack created with GitHub Stacks CLI • Give Feedback 💬

+### 3.5 Eager Pipeline Parallelism
+
+`DeepSeekV3Model.pipeline()` selects `pipeline_dsv3()` when MTP is enabled.
+That function extends the normal decoder split and delegates partitioning,
+parallelization, and scheduling to `pipeline_llm()`. The automatic split counts
+the MTP block as an additional unit of work on the final virtual stage; an
+explicit split retains its configured main-layer placement.
+
+| Owner | Modules and work |
+| --- | --- |
+| First virtual stage | Canonical `tok_embeddings`; first main decoder layers |
+| Intermediate stages | Their main decoder layers; hidden-state input/output |
+| Final virtual stage | Remaining main layers, embedding replica, MTP block, norm and LM head |
+
+```text
+each PP rank: same local batch -> shifted IDs, masks, labels, attention metadata
+                                  | rank-local root kwargs
+                                  v
+first stage                 intermediate stages                 final stage
+main IDs -> embedding -> h -------> decoder -> h ------------------+-> norm -> LM logits
+                                                                  |
+final-stage local shifted IDs ----------------> embedding replica --+-> MTP -> MTP logits
+                                                                      |
+                                                          combined training loss
+```
+
+Only `h` crosses pipeline edges. Shifted IDs are already available from the
+rank-local batch and add no activation payload to P2P communication. The final
+stage uses one shared LM head for the main and MTP predictions.
+
+Both physical embedding copies retain `tok_embeddings.weight`. Existing model
+and optimizer checkpoint keys therefore remain canonical. Model-owned private
+hooks synchronize their local FSDP/TP shards after initialization and checkpoint
+loading, then sum their gradients after all pipeline microbatches and before
+gradient clipping. The replica contributes zero additional weight to the
+global norm, but both physical copies are clipped with the same factor and
+updated by their optimizers. PP2 reuses its existing PP group for these owner
+collectives; every PP4 rank participates in a collective split of its PP
+group, and only the two embedding owners join the resulting subgroup.
+
+`deepseek_v3_debugmodel_mtp_pp2_dp2_ep2()` is the four-GPU integration recipe:
+MTP1, eager Interleaved1F1B, PP2/DP2/EP2, four pipeline microbatches and ten
+deterministic optimizer steps. Real process groups are required. CPU-offloaded
+embedding synchronization, fake-PG MTP pipeline metadata, and MTP+PP+CP are
+currently unsupported. GraphTrainer must implement its own MTP graph ownership
+and scheduling; it is outside this eager integration.
+

+def pipeline_dsv3(
+    model: DeepSeekV3Model,
+    *,
+    parallelism_context: ParallelismContext,
+    parallelism: ParallelismConfig,
+    model_config: DeepSeekV3Model.Config,

+    """Place MTP1 and an embedding replica on the final virtual stage.

+    if model.num_mtp_layers != 1:
+        raise NotImplementedError("DeepSeek-V3 pipeline parallelism supports MTP1.")
+    if parallelism_context.cp_enabled:
+        raise NotImplementedError("MTP pipeline context parallelism is a TODO.")
+    if kwargs["training"].enable_cpu_offload:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "MTP pipeline embedding synchronization requires device parameters."
+        )
+    pp_mesh = parallelism_context.get_mesh("pp")

+    if pp_backend == "fake":
+        raise NotImplementedError(

+        )

+    # 1. Extend the core decoder partition without mutating the caller's config.
+    parallelism = copy.copy(parallelism)

+    if configured is None:
+        parallelism.pipeline_parallel_last_stage_less_layers += model.num_mtp_layers

+            model,
+            first_stage_module_fqns=(),
+            last_stage_module_fqns=(),
+            parallelism_context=parallelism_context,
+            parallelism=parallelism,
+            model_config=model_config,
+        )
+    else:
+        module_fqns = copy.deepcopy(configured)
+    if "tok_embeddings" not in module_fqns[0]:
+        raise ValueError("The first MTP pipeline stage must own tok_embeddings.")
+    if any(
+        fqn == "tok_embeddings" or fqn.startswith("mtp_layers.")
+        for part in module_fqns[1:-1]
+        for fqn in part
+    ) or any(fqn.startswith("mtp_layers.") for fqn in module_fqns[0]):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MTP layers and the embedding replica belong to the final stage."
+        )
+    for fqn in ("mtp_layers.0", "tok_embeddings"):
+        if fqn not in module_fqns[-1]:
+            module_fqns[-1].append(fqn)
+    parallelism.pipeline_parallel_module_fqns_per_model_part = module_fqns

+        parallelism=parallelism,

+            parallelism.pipeline_parallel_schedule,

+        for rank in range(pp_mesh.size())
+    }

+    ):

+
+    owner_ranks = [
+        rank
+        for rank, stages in rank_stages.items()
+        if 0 in stages or len(module_fqns) - 1 in stages
+    ]

+    group = pp_mesh.get_group() if len(owner_ranks) == pp_mesh.size() else None
+    if len(owner_ranks) > 1 and group is None:
+        # Every PP parent rank participates, including non-embedding owners.
+        group = dist.split_group(
+            parent_pg=pp_mesh.get_group(), split_ranks=[owner_ranks]
+        )
+    if has_first or has_last:
+        source_rank = int(
+            pp_mesh.mesh[
+                next(rank for rank, stages in rank_stages.items() if 0 in stages)
+            ]
+        )
+        if group is not None and not isinstance(group, dist.ProcessGroup):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "MTP embedding owners must be members of their synchronization group."
+            )
+        for part in dsv3_parts:
+            if part.tok_embeddings is not None:
+                part._mtp_embedding_group = group
+                part._mtp_embedding_src_rank = source_rank

+def _local_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return the local FSDP/TP shard used by the PP owner collective."""
+    return tensor.to_local() if isinstance(tensor, DTensor) else tensor

+def _synchronize_mtp_embeddings(model_parts: list[DeepSeekV3Model]) -> None:
+    """Synchronize physical embedding copies after init or checkpoint loading."""
+    owners = [

+        for part in model_parts
+        if part._mtp_pipeline_enabled and part.tok_embeddings is not None
+    ]
+    if len(owners) == 2:
+        first = next(part for part in owners if part._mtp_pipeline_first_stage)
+        last = next(part for part in owners if not part._mtp_pipeline_first_stage)

+    elif owners and owners[0]._mtp_embedding_group is not None:
+        owner = owners[0]
+        dist.broadcast(
+            _local_tensor(owner.tok_embeddings.weight),
+            src=owner._mtp_embedding_src_rank,
+            group=owner._mtp_embedding_group,

+def _finalize_mtp_embedding_gradients(model_parts: list[DeepSeekV3Model]) -> None:

+    if any(part.tok_embeddings.weight.grad is None for part in owners):

+    if len(owners) == 2:

+        last_grad = _local_tensor(owners[1].tok_embeddings.weight.grad)
+        first_grad.add_(last_grad)
+        last_grad.copy_(first_grad)

+        owner = owners[0]
